names.name: B & H Bakery Distributors
names.said: The supplier is the part of the trade nobody photographs.

text.what: A Cambodian-American bakery supply business serving California donut shops.
text.story: Dorothy Chow told KQED that her father, a survivor of the Cambodian genocide, built the business "to help our own people". Suppliers like it are how a shop opens in a week: flour, mix, boxes, fryer parts, and the knowledge of who is selling a shop.
text.today: A distributor is the piece of infrastructure that makes an independent trade behave like a network.
